name: Valyupeak Competitor Price Tracking and Repricing
author: valyupeak

sections.description:
Valyupeak helps WooCommerce store owners keep their prices competitive without watching competitors all day. See how your prices compare to your competitors, get undercut alerts, and reprice for profit, right inside WooCommerce.

This plugin connects your WooCommerce store to Valyupeak, a third party competitor price tracking and repricing service. The tracking and repricing run on Valyupeak’s servers; the plugin authenticates with your API key and shows the results inside your WordPress admin. A free Valyupeak account is required.

What you can do with the free plugin:

  • See each product’s competitor price next to your own price, as a column on the Products screen.
  • Get an alert by email and in your dashboard when a competitor undercuts you.
  • Review a suggested price and apply it to a product with one click.
  • Track a starter set of products and competitors on the free plan.

Upgrade on Valyupeak for more:

  • Track more products and competitors.
  • Turn on fully automated repricing that stays inside the margin floors you set.
  • Deeper true-price tracking that accounts for shipping and promotions, plus catalog matching at scale.

External service

This plugin connects to Valyupeak, a third party service that performs competitor price tracking and repricing. A Valyupeak account is required for the plugin to function.

When you use the plugin, your product data (such as product identifiers, your prices, and the competitors you choose to track) is sent to Valyupeak so the service can track prices and return results to your store.

  • Service: Valyupeak, https://valyupeak.com
  • Terms of Use: https://valyupeak.com/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://valyupeak.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen, or upload it to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Create a free account at https://valyupeak.com and copy your API key.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > Valyupeak and paste your API key to connect your store.
  4. Choose the products and competitors you want to track, then save.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Valyupeak account?

Yes. The plugin connects to the Valyupeak service, which does the price tracking. A free account is enough to get started.

Is it really free?

The plugin is free, and Valyupeak has a free plan. Higher plans on Valyupeak add more products, more competitors, and automated repricing.

Does it change my prices automatically?

Not on the free plan. You review a suggested price and apply it yourself with one click. Automated repricing within your margin floors is available on higher Valyupeak plans.

What data is sent to Valyupeak?

Product identifiers, your prices, and the competitors you choose to track, so the service can monitor prices and return results. See the External service and Privacy sections.

Does it work with any WooCommerce store?

It is built for standard WooCommerce product catalogs. It works best for stores selling products that other stores also sell, where competitor pricing matters.
